scheme_name: Grant-in-Aid to Non-governmental Organisations Running Residential Homes for the Children, Aged, and Vulnerable Persons Under Social Defence
other_conditions: NGO must be running residential homes for orphans, destitute and street children, aged and infirm persons, and physically and mentally disabled persons
NGO must be registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, or a public trust under any applicable law, or a charitable company licensed under Section 25 of the Companies Act, 1956
NGO should have existed continuously for at least three years at the time of application (relaxable in deserving cases)
NGO must be licensed by the Department of Social Welfare under the Women and Children Licensing Rules, 1956
NGO must have a properly constituted managing body with clearly defined powers, duties and responsibilities in writing
NGO must be in a sound financial position
NGO must have necessary facilities and resources to run the residential homes
NGO must be non‑sectarian and provide services irrespective of religion, caste, colour or creed
NGO must not be run for profit of any individual or group
NGO must be free from corrupt practices
benefits_summary: Provides a grant-in-aid of ₹500 per inmate per month for 12 months, limited to 90% of the estimated cost.
